title: Yelin group meditation: synchronized binaural session with about 30 people and orb contact

tellings.quote: So what that looked like is I took a group of about 30 people.

plain: At an outdoor place called Yelin, about 30 people meditated together while listening in sync to binaural sound, tones played slightly differently in each ear to guide the mind, and the group made contact with orbs, balls of light. Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a UFO program as a child, tells Michels he led the group himself: "I took a group of about 30 people."
